# no-background-only-scenario

Disallow a Background that applies to exactly one Scenario.

| Category | Recommended | Safe autofix | Default options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| structure | no | no | none |

Finds a Background whose Feature or Rule has exactly one Scenario.

## Configuration

```json

```
